finding.mismatch: Guide treats ownership defaults as mandatory readback policy and claims uncaptured-handler-only error delivery. Public blocking_validation can be overridden on native; borrowed/browser scope skipping can leave a matching caller scope to capture the error. Root context docs already state configured-error-handling policy.
finding.proposed_wording: Native contexts that own their device read back the validation scope before returning by default. Borrowed contexts disable this blocking readback by default, and browser builds omit it. On these paths, native failures follow the device's configured error handling, including caller-installed scopes, rather than a synchronous `TextureViewError`.
